sound_enabled.label: Sounds
sound_enabled.description: Play Mochi's sounds on state changes and reactions.

show_tool.label: Show active tool
show_tool.description: Show the tool the agent is running (Bash, Edit…) next to Mochi.

size.label: Mochi size
size.description: Size of the desktop Mochi, in pixels.

outfit.label: Outfit
outfit.description: What Mochi wears. Auto follows the seasons (party hat, Santa hat, witch hat, bunny ears, sunglasses).

mochi_surface.label: Where Mochi lives
mochi_surface.description: Overlay: Mochi floats above your windows on the focused monitor (coucou-mochi). Desktop widget: Noctalia's desktop layer, under the windows. Both: the two.

overlay_size.label: Overlay size
overlay_size.description: Side of the floating Mochi, in pixels (the original is 120).

overlay_layer.label: Overlay layer
overlay_layer.description: Top: above windows, under fullscreen ones (like the original). Overlay: above fullscreen windows too.

overlay_follow_cursor.label: Eyes follow the pointer
overlay_follow_cursor.description: Mochi looks at the pointer while he is awake (Hyprland's cursor position, a few times a second).

overlay_peek.label: Peek from the top edge
overlay_peek.description: Dropped against the top edge, Mochi hides there and peeks out when the pointer comes.

overlay_open_on_hover.label: Open on hover
overlay_open_on_hover.description: While he peeks from the top edge, hovering him opens the approval panel.

overlay_show_text.label: Text under Mochi
overlay_show_text.description: Write the greeting and the running tool under Mochi on the overlay.

notify_finished.label: Notify when a session finishes
notify_finished.description: Show the agent's final message in a notification.

panel.send_failed: Could not reach coucou-daemon; the agent will ask in its terminal.

agents.title: Agents
agents.intro: Show your coding agents in Mochi. You see the exact change and where the backup goes before anything is written; disconnecting removes only what Coucou added.
agents.load_failed: Could not list the agents (is coucou-daemon installed?).
agents.no_relay: The relay (coucou-hook) isn't installed, so agents cannot be connected yet.
agents.approvals: Sessions, and Allow / Deny from Mochi
agents.display_only: Sessions; approvals stay in the agent
agents.preview_connect_hint: This is exactly what changes. Nothing else is touched.
agents.preview_remove_hint: This removes Coucou's entries only. Everything else stays.
agents.up_to_date: Already up to date: nothing to write.
agents.no_backup: No existing file: nothing to back up.

chat.intro: Ask me anything. The model name above opens the provider and model picker; the key button holds your API keys.
chat.no_key: No API key — add it with the key button.
chat.attach: Attach the file you copied (Ctrl+C in the file manager)
chat.attach_none: Copy a file in your file manager first (Ctrl+C), then click the clip.
chat.keys_intro: Keys go to the system keyring (Secret Service). Mochi only ever sees whether one is saved.
chat.key_failed: Could not save the key (is the keyring unlocked?).
chat.custom_url_first: Save the custom server's address first: the key is only ever sent there.
chat.servers_intro: Ollama, LM Studio or any OpenAI-compatible server. Empty means the usual address on this computer.
